apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.3.0 — Varisai lesson screen rebuilt as the Practice Dock layout (option 1 from the mockups): one compact pattern row (name + Pattern N of M + prev/next), metadata chips, the notation grid as the hero, Laya/Tala collapsed to a single row that taps open, Sa/Speed/Labels as a bare chip row, and a sticky bottom dock with Play, Loop and the tempo slider. The Patterns card and the repeated title/sub block are gone.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
